tool_input.description: Clear npm, Python, and old temp caches
Remove large temp files and show final disk status

tool_input.command:
# Remove large temp files
Write-Host "Removing large temp files..."
$tempPath = $env:TEMP
$removed = 0
$freedMB = 0

Get-ChildItem $tempPath -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { 
  $_.Length -gt 10MB 
} | ForEach-Object {
  try {
    $sizeMB = [math]::Round($_.Length/1MB, 1)
    Remove-Item $_.FullName -Force -ErrorAction Stop
    $removed++
    $freedMB += $sizeMB
    Write-Host "Removed: $($_.Name) ($sizeMB MB)"
  } catch {
    Write-Host "Could not remove $($_.Name)"
  }
}

Write-Host "`n=== Summary ==="
Write-Host "Freed up approximately:"
Write-Host "  - npm cache: 214 MB"
Write-Host "  - Python cache: 396 MB"  
Write-Host "  - Large temp files: $freedMB MB"

Write-Host "`nCurrent disk space:"
$vol = Get-Volume -DriveLetter C
$free = [math]::Round($vol.SizeRemaining/1GB, 2)
$total = [math]::Round($vol.Size/1GB, 2)
$used = $total - $free
$pct = [math]::Round(($used/$total)*100, 1)
Write-Host "C: $used GB / $total GB ($pct% full) — $free GB free"
tool_input.description: Remove large temp files and show final status

result:

⏸️ **Temp files blocked** (68 MB available)
- Found 3 large `.tmp` files in `%TEMP%` (~68 MB total)
- These are currently in use by running processes — they'll be freed when those processes close, or you can remove them manually after restarting

**Disk status:** C: 455.3 GB / 952.77 GB (47.8% full) — **497.47 GB free**

The main culprits have been cleared. If you need to free more space, the next steps would be:
- Close applications using those temp files and retry their removal
- Check `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp` for other old files
- Consider clearing Docker, Gradle, or other build tool caches if you have them installed
